assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: ONE finished square button texture for a Crusader Kings III AGOT holding-management interface, active/enabled state. Subject: UPGRADE THE MAIN HOLDING BUILDING. Draw one large, extremely simple frontal crenellated castle tower with a broad upward arrow on its right, clearly distinguishable at 56 x 56 pixels. Square 1:1 composition, front view, no perspective. A very thin plain antique-bronze rectangular frame inset 5% from the image edge, enclosing a flat near-black charcoal-blue panel (#171d23). Centered pictogram fills about 68% of the canvas. Pictogram is solid warm light bronze (#c9ad75) with restrained pale edge highlights, broad clean silhouettes and minimal engraved shading. Tower has three large battlements and a single dark arched opening; arrow is bold and unmistakable, not another turret. Match sober medieval strategy-game UI, tiny amount of material texture only, high readability. No elaborate ornaments, no dragons, no heraldry, no scenery, no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no extra icons, no presentation sheet. Background is the opaque dark button panel, not transparency. Output only this single button, square, 1024 x 1024.

No redesign, no blur, no new objects, no cross-out, no lock, no text, no watermark. One square button only, not a side-by-side comparison.
